$Comment: A Turkey Soul: the restless ghost of a hunted turkey, raised only by the Turkey Graveyard's fight (EncounterManager/Harvest_Feast/Harvest_Feast_Great_Turkey_Encounter.json): in waves around the fountain before the Great Turkey wakes, and at its side as its health falls. It never spawns in the wild. It is a Variant of Template_Predator carrying the game's Undead Chicken's own Modify (an undead bird that charges and pecks), with the look, the senses, the leash, the drop list and the nameplate changed: it wears the Turkey Soul look (Models/Harvest_Feast/NPC/Harvest_Feast_Turkey_Soul.json), sees all round and turns on a player quickly so a wave comes at the party at once, stays awake at night, drops nothing (it is a spirit), and stays out of the Memories collection. _CombatConfig puts the ghostly sheen on it (Harvest_Feast_Turkey_Soul_Glow) for as long as it stands. It is in Harvest_Feast_Turkey_Soul_Group alone, which its fight waits on and sweeps; it is in no group Martha's favor counts and no quest or tally names it, so putting one down never counts as hunting a turkey, and the graveyard can never pay for its own way in. Melee_Damage's BaseDamage is one peck before armour. Any key the template does not declare makes the game refuse the whole role.
